businessGoal: Allow visitors to browse available products easily.

scenarios.goal: Verify that a grid of product cards is displayed showing all products when navigating to the home page.
Verify that each product card displays a product image, name, and price when the product overview is shown.
Verify that clicking on a product card navigates to the corresponding product detail page.

clarifications: Behavior for navigating back from the product detail page to the product overview is not specified.
No information on what happens if there are no products available.
